item.title: Sixers’ Tyrese Maxey out with sprained pinky finger

item.title: 2 Bucks County teens arrested after IED tossed at New York City protest
item.description: Two Bucks County teens were arrested in connection with an IED thrown at an anti-Muslim protest outside Gracie Mansion in New York City on Saturday.

item.title: Pa. state police trooper shot and killed in Chester County [Updated]
item.description: A Pennsylvania state police trooper was shot and killed during a traffic stop in West Caln Township on Sunday night, Gov. Josh Shapiro said.

item.title: Romance books convention will have a second chapter

item.title: POINT: Time changes have advantages year-round
item.description: America’s current daylight saving time system — spring-to-fall DST followed by winter standard time — is an excellent compromise, providing all of DST’s many benefits for the majority of the year and yet avoiding winter DST’s difficulties during the dark, cold months. item.title: COMMUNITY DIGEST: March 9, 2026
item.description: Greater Hazleton Area and beyond Hazleton Area School Retirees breakfast: 9:15 a.m. Wednesday, March 11. Tom’s Kitchen. Any recent or long-time retirees may join. Order from the menu. All-Campus Food Drive: Monday, March 9 to Friday, March 20. Luzerne County Community College. To support students in need. Students, faculty, staff, and community members encouraged to donate non-perishable food items to help stock the college’s student food pantries. Donation bins in the main lobby of each campus.
